title: Combating Homelessness Stigma with LLMs: A New Multi-Modal Dataset for Bias Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text from social media, news articles, and city council meeting minutes using various LLMs (zero-shot and few-shot) and BERT to classify discourse into 16 specific categories of bias against people experiencing homelessness (PEH), such as 'Harmful Generalization', 'Not in My Backyard', and 'Deserving/Undeserving'.
Classifying text segments into a 'racist' category using human annotators and LLM classifiers as one of the dimensions within the broader multi-modal bias classification framework.
